en.name: Quarto documents
en.description: Opens Quarto's .qmd files in Textus's editor, their divs, shortcodes and attributes kept as written.
en.tool.quarto_project: Reads the open folder's _quarto.yml: the Quarto project's title, formats and output folder. Use it before changing how a .qmd document renders.

zh.name: Quarto 文档
zh.description: 在 Textus 编辑器里打开 Quarto 的 .qmd 文件，其中的 div、短代码和属性按原样保留。
zh.tool.quarto_project: 读取打开的文件夹里的 _quarto.yml：Quarto 项目的标题、输出格式和输出目录。改 .qmd 的渲染方式之前先读它。
